crop.notes: Clipping ends mid-sentence at the start of the main bout ('the men met in the centre of the ring'); the round-by-round account continues on the page. The Allen passage is complete.

title.suggested: Tom Allen in Charley Mitchell's Corner at the Olympic Club, New Orleans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Tom Allen, with Frank Slavin and Pat Allen, accompanied Charley Mitchell into the ring for his sparring bout with Arthur Upham before the Fitzsimmons-Maher fight in New Orleans. Allen was applauded.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Republic, Thursday Morning, March 3, 1892, page 1. Dispatch dated New Orleans, March 2.

facts.fact: Allen, with Frank Slavin and Pat Allen, accompanied Charley Mitchell into the ring for his four-round sparring bout with Arthur Upham at the Olympic Club, New Orleans, before the Fitzsimmons-Maher fight, and was received with applause

notes: The text says Mitchell was 'accompanied by' Allen, not that Allen seconded him, so the current title's 'Seconds' overstates it. Publication name given with period as on masthead.
